questions.prompt: A bag contains 8 counters of different colours, including 1 gold counter. Three counters are chosen at random without replacement.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the gold counter is chosen.

questions.prompt: Seven books, consisting of 3 novels and 4 biographies, are arranged in a line on a shelf in random order.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the first 3 books are all novels.

questions.prompt: A team of 3 students is chosen at random from a group of 5 boys and 4 girls.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the team consists entirely of boys.

questions.prompt: A committee of 2 members is selected at random from 10 committee candidates, of whom 4 are teachers and 6 are parents.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the probability that both selected members are teachers.

questions.prompt: Six runners, labelled A, B, C, D, E, and F, finish a race with no ties. All finishing orders are equally likely.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that runner A finishes first.

questions.prompt: Eight different paintings are hung in a row along a gallery wall in random order. Two of the paintings are by the same artist.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the two paintings by the same artist are not hung next to each other.

questions.prompt: A committee of 4 members is to be chosen at random from a group of 6 boys and 4 girls.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the committee contains exactly 2 boys and 2 girls.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the committee contains at least 3 girls.

questions.prompt: The 6 letters of the word VECTOR are arranged in a random line.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the two vowels (E and O) are at the two ends of the arrangement.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the two vowels are not next to each other.

questions.prompt: A box contains 12 marbles: 5 red, 4 blue, and 3 green. Four marbles are selected at random without replacement.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that exactly 2 red and 2 blue marbles are selected.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the selection contains at least one marble of each colour.

questions.prompt: A 5-digit number is formed by selecting and arranging 5 different digits from the set {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7}. All such 5-digit numbers are equally likely to be formed.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the number formed is greater than 50000.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the number formed is odd and less than 40000.

questions.prompt: Seven people, including Alex, Beth, and Carl, are seated in a row of 7 chairs in random order.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Alex and Beth sit next to each other, but Carl does not sit next to either of them.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Alex, Beth, and Carl are all separated from one another so that no two of them sit in adjacent chairs.

questions.prompt: The 10 letters of the word STATISTICS are arranged in a random line.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the arrangement begins and ends with the letter S.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that all three letters T are next to each other.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the probability that no two letters S are next to each other.

questions.prompt: A hospital committee of 6 people is chosen at random from a group of 5 doctors, 4 nurses, and 3 dentists.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the committee contains at least 3 doctors, at least 1 nurse, and at least 1 dentist.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Two specific doctors, Dr Adams and Dr Baker, refuse to serve together on the committee. Find the probability that Dr Adams and Dr Baker are not both selected for the committee.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Given that the committee contains no dentists, find the probability that it contains strictly more doctors than nurses.
